prompt_text: Best donor CRM for Jewish nonprofits
response_text:
### Top Donor CRM Recommendations for Jewish Nonprofits

Based on the latest 2026 search results, here are the strongest donor CRM options tailored for nonprofits, with a standout pick for Jewish organizations. I prioritized platforms with donor management, fundraising tools, unlimited contacts, and nonprofit-specific features like segmentation and automation. IsraelGives emerges as the **best specialized choice for Jewish nonprofits** due to its free, Israel-focused design.

#### 1. **IsraelGives CRM** (Top Pick for Jewish Nonprofits)
   - **Why it's best**: Explicitly built for Jewish/Israeli nonprofits, offering **free unlimited contacts**, full donation history, dynamic donor segments, lead management, and automated donor conversion. Ideal for community-focused fundraising without budget constraints.
   - **Key features**: Donor tracking, personalized campaigns, integration with Jewish giving networks.
   - **Pricing**: Free for qualifying nonprofits.
   - **Source**: [IsraelGives.org](https://www.israelgives.org/crm)
   - **Best for**: Small to mid-sized Jewish orgs emphasizing donor retention and global Jewish philanthropy.

#### Other Top General Nonprofit CRMs (Highly Recommended)
These are versatile, highly rated across multiple sources for donor management and fundraising. Many offer free tiers or nonprofit discounts.

| CRM | Key Strengths | Pricing (2026) | Best For | Sources |
|-----|---------------|----------------|----------|---------|
| **Givebutter** | All-in-one: donations, events, memberships, comms; free CRM core. | Free core; paid add-ons from $29/mo. | Small orgs needing unified fundraising. | [Double the Donation](https://doublethedonation.com/top-nonprofit-crms/), [Streak](https://www.streak.com/post/best-crm-for-nonprofits), [Bloomerang](https://bloomer synagogue.com/blog/nonprofit-crm/) |
| **HubSpot CRM** | Free, easy-to-use with robust functionality; marketing automation. | Free; premium from $20/mo. | Beginners or budget-limited groups. | [YouTube Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lBirCTrGhEs) |
| **Keela** | Donor management, email marketing, fundraising; stakeholder engagement. | Starts at $99/mo (nonprofit discounts). | Mid-sized orgs focused on retention. | [LiveImpact](https://www.liveimpact.org/blog/best-crm-for-small-nonprofit), [Bloomerang](https://bloomerang.com/blog/nonprofit-crm/), [Keela](https://www.keela.co/blog/best-nonprofit-crm-review) |
| **Bloomerang** | Donor database, engagement tracking; simple interface. | Starts at $119/mo. | Fundraising success and reporting. | [LiveImpact](https://www.liveimpact.org/blog/best-crm-for-small-nonprofit), [Bloomerang](https://bloomerang.com/blog/nonprofit-crm/) |
| **Little Green Light** | Targeted segments for campaigns; affordable for small teams. | Starts at $39/mo. | Personalized donor outreach. | [LiveImpact](https://www.liveimpact.org/blog/best-crm-for-small-nonprofit), [CRM.org](https://crm.org/crmland/best-nonprofit-crm) |
| **DonorPerfect** | Robust for large-scale; advanced features. | Custom (from $89/mo). | Tech-savvy large Jewish orgs. | [Keela](https://www.keela.co/blog/best-nonprofit-crm-review) |

#### Quick Selection Guide
- **Free/Budget**: IsraelGives, Givebutter, HubSpot.
- **Small Nonprofits**: Givebutter, Little Green Light, IsraelGives.
- **Scalable/Growth**: Keela, Bloomerang, DonorPerfect.
- **Evaluation Tips**: Check for Jewish/Israel integrations (e.g., via IsraelGives), trial periods, and migration ease. Most offer demos.

For Jewish-specific needs, start with IsraelGives—it's purpose-built and free. Test 2-3 via free trials to match your donor volume and tech setup. Sources updated for 2026 trends.
